caption: The drawing depicts a wooden chair with a tall, rectangular backrest that features natural wood grain patterns in shades of brown and reddish-brown. The chair's back is paneled and extends higher than the armrests, with a horizontal molding at the top. The armrests are supported by turned wooden spindles, which are cylindrical and vertically oriented, matching the decorative legs of the chair. The seat is flat and solid, and the front and side supports each consist of two turned legs connected by stretchers, with an additional horizontal stretcher running between the front legs near the floor. The entire chair exhibits a consistent wood color with darker and lighter brown tones emphasizing the wood's texture and grain. The drawing is surrounded by a rectangular border and is set against a plain, light tan background with a thin frame.
title: Chair-table
